sources.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one original transparent fantasy RPG empty-inventory illustration, not a UI screenshot. Subject: a CLEARLY EMPTY small medieval armory rack, broad squat silhouette, two weathered charcoal-brown oak uprights supporting a worn horizontal bar with three bare iron hooks and an empty lower slatted shelf; the hooks and shelf contain absolutely nothing. A modest low stone footing is part of the rack. Elegant restrained antique brass corner brackets, scratched blackened iron, rough aged wood grain, a little chipped patina. Hand-painted high-end dark fantasy inventory art with tactile matte materials, crisp readable silhouette and soft diffuse upper-left light, matching painted scuffed bronze/dark-iron equipment illustrations. Muted umber, desaturated charcoal, faint dusty gold edges; LOW contrast, restful and subordinate to gold text. Full object visible, front three-quarter view, centered with generous transparent margins, compact wide composition. Genuine alpha transparency around the object, no background or scene, no surrounding haze/glow. Empty means EMPTY: no weapons, armor, shields, potions, coins, crystals, treasure, rewards, loot silhouettes, characters, text, symbols, letters, numbers, labels, frames or UI. No glossy plastic, toy-like 3D, shiny gold, bright magic, bloom, sparkles or cast shadow outside the rack. This is an original quiet empty-state illustration, not copied from any game.

Edit this empty armory rack illustration only to clean transparency. Keep the same entire EMPTY rack, wood grain, bare hooks, matte worn iron and dusty brass, composition and proportions. Remove ALL brown fog, backdrop, glow and cast shadows around the rack AND in the large empty opening between the uprights; those spaces must be genuinely fully alpha-transparent. Keep only the solid physical rack/stone footing and its clean antialiased edges. No weapons, gear, objects, words or new elements. No shiny plastic. True transparent PNG cutout.
